veranderings.voor: Daarna het Suid-Afrika elke wedstryd gewen
veranderings.na: Daarna het hulle elke wedstryd gewen
veranderings.rede: The subject switches from 'die Springbokke' to 'Suid-Afrika' and the next sentence's 'hulle' then points back to a singular country; keeping 'hulle' (the Springbokke) makes the reference clear.
Touring several cities one after another is 'deur' stede toer; 'na' reads as travelling to one destination.
